python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.planning import get_scene_planner, get_plan_serializer
from src.runtime.semantic import get_intent_serializer
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Scene_Plan_Create(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_scene_plan_create"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("scene_intent_json", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_output("scene_plan_json",      "string")
        self.add_output("plan_id",              "string")
        self.add_output("zone_count",           "int")
        self.add_output("asset_query_count",    "int")
        self.add_output("estimated_complexity", "string")
        self.add_output("planning_ok",          "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        intent_json = inputs.get("scene_intent_json", "") or ""
        if not intent_json.strip():
            self.log_error("No scene_intent_json provided.")
            return {"scene_plan_json": "", "plan_id": "", "zone_count": 0,
                    "asset_query_count": 0, "estimated_complexity": "",
                    "planning_ok": False, "exec_out": True}
        try:
            intent = get_intent_serializer().from_json(intent_json)
            result = get_scene_planner().plan(intent)
            if not result.ok or result.plan is None:
                self.log_error(f"Planning failed: {result.errors}")
                return {"scene_plan_json": "", "plan_id": "", "zone_count": 0,
                        "asset_query_count": 0, "estimated_complexity": "",
                        "planning_ok": False, "exec_out": True}
            plan = result.plan
            plan_json = get_plan_serializer().to_json(plan)
            self.log_info(f"Plan created: {len(plan.zones)} zones, {len(plan.asset_queries)} queries, complexity={plan.estimated_complexity!r}")
            return {
                "scene_plan_json":      plan_json,
                "plan_id":              plan.plan_id,
                "zone_count":           len(plan.zones),
                "asset_query_count":    len(plan.asset_queries),
                "estimated_complexity": plan.estimated_complexity,
                "planning_ok":          True,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Scene planning failed: {exc}")
            return {"scene_plan_json": "", "plan_id": "", "zone_count": 0,
                    "asset_query_count": 0, "estimated_complexity": "",
                    "planning_ok": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Scene_Plan_Create
